svg.title: Honeycomb: cell geometry, one frame, the cell unit
svg.desc: Perimeter of regular polygons of unit area, a frame of 2,032 offset hexagonal cells filled by kind, and the cell unit against the largest frame.
svg.text: Hive: why hexagons, the frame arrangement, the cell unit
Left: wall length per cell. Middle: brood in the centre, pollen around it, royal jelly below, honey above (convention, not measurement). Right: 1 cell = one power-of-two unit.
sides n of a regular polygon
